The 11 manual-package papers of ROADMAP 3.11 (139 pinned claims), from 88 results files, 231 cells.  A separate group: none of these numbers enters a 24-paper total.  Each cell is claims within tolerance of the paper's printed value, summed over the eleven papers (first scored; claims within tolerance of the I4R replicator's value).  Pipeline samples 1–4 are the frozen pipeline through the oracle (labels `desktop-opus`, `-run2`, `-run3`, `-run4`); agent samples 1–4 are Claude Code runs a–d.  Seeded mode has three pipeline samples and two agent samples.  The last column counts the papers whose cell matched every claim, sample by sample.
